en.t: At last, the weather cleared today.

units.source_text: 源氏公子如此久居宫中，深恐岳父左大臣心中不悦，今天就回左大臣邸。

en.t: Prince Genji had stayed so long at court that, fearing his father-in-law the Minister of the Left might be displeased, he returned today to the minister's mansion.

units.source_text: 走进葵姬房里一看，四周布置得秩序井然；

en.t: When he entered Lady Aoi's rooms and looked around, everything was arranged in perfect order;

units.source_text: 尤其是这个人，气品高雅，毫无半点瑕疵。

en.t: above all, she herself was refined and elegant, without the slightest flaw.

units.source_text: 他想：“这正是左马头所推重选拔的忠实可靠的贤妻吧。”

en.t: He thought, "This must be exactly the faithful and dependable good wife whom the Head of the Left Stable praised and chose."

units.source_text: 然而又觉得过于端严庄重，似乎难于亲近，不免美中不足，实为遗憾。

en.t: Yet he also felt that she was too proper and dignified, seemingly hard to approach, and this unavoidable imperfection in her beauty was truly regrettable.

units.source_text: 他就同几个姿色翘楚的青年侍女如中纳言君、中务君等随意调笑取乐。

en.t: So he amused himself by casually joking and flirting with several especially attractive young gentlewomen, such as Chūnagon no Kimi and Nakatsukasa no Kimi.

units.source_text: 这时候天气甚热，公子缓带披襟，姿态潇洒，

en.t: At the time the weather was very hot, and the prince loosened his sash and opened his collar, looking effortlessly graceful,

units.source_text: 侍女们看了，个个心中艳羡不已。

en.t: and when the gentlewomen saw him, every one of them was filled with admiring envy.
The Minister of the Left also arrived.

units.source_text: 他看见源氏公子随意不拘的样子，

en.t: Seeing Prince Genji in such an easy and unrestrained state,

units.source_text: 觉得不便入内，便在帷屏外就座，想和公子隔着屏障谈话。

en.t: he felt it would be awkward to enter, so he sat down outside the curtain screen and tried to speak with the prince through the partition.

units.source_text: 公子说：“天气这么热……”说着，皱了皱眉头。

en.t: The prince said, "With weather this hot..." and as he spoke, he frowned slightly.
The gentlewomen all burst out laughing.
The prince said, "Quiet down a little!"

units.source_text: 就把手臂靠在矮几上，态度煞是悠闲。

en.t: Then he rested his arm on a low table, looking exceedingly relaxed.
